Screening only. Historical mine maps can be incomplete or inaccurately located. Before any purchase, design, permit or construction decision, the conditions must be confirmed by a physical site investigation (borings and/or geophysics) by a licensed professional engineer or geologist.
Placed within 15-19 m of PA DEP's own placement. The 1922 pit-mouth elevation note matches modern USGS ground to -. Seam: a plane through the ten rail elevations written along the haulage (976.7-986.4 ft; fit within 0.7 m), rising gently to the northeast. Route: pit mouth, 1 Face Entry, then the butt entries; bends between written elevations are interpolated. Building heights are illustrative. Sources: PA DEP / PASDA mine map 0900-002, USGS 3DEP, Allegheny County GIS.
